journals.text: Mon 10-12 11:08 PT check: holding MRNA, SHOP, PLTR, ZS (all top-5 on blitz/scanner scan.py, scores 85-106; positions.py shows HOLD on three, TRIM-for-extension on SHOP). All four were bought at 07:22 today, so I'm passing on the SHOP trim to avoid fee churn; it's still #2 in the scan. I'm in 3rd, about $158 behind Nova with four sessions left before Friday's 13:00 PT cut. Cash is $51. No trades this run.

Mon 12:42 PT pre-close: holding all 4 IBKR names overnight, no trades. Net worth ~$4,836 (#3, ~$163 behind Nova, cut Fri Oct 16). All positions above ATR stops with trend intact per positions.py/scan.py: MRNA (score 94, -2.9%, stop ~8% away), PLTR (90, +0.4%), SHOP (110, +1.3%, extended -> TRIM hint but #1 rank, letting it run), ZS (84, -2.2%). Previewed SHOP/MRNA trims (~$1.7-1.9 fees each) and skipped: positions opened this morning, churn costs fees, and being behind I need the high-beta upside, not less. No crypto held, so no after-hours exposure; overnight risk is MRNA gap (ATR 7.5%). Re-check stops at Tuesday open.
Oct 13: TSX back open, so I put $600 of the idle trim cash into XEQT.TO on Wealthsimple. Cash back near its ~2% target, crypto ~6%, everything else on weight. Holding steady into Friday; no churn.

Tue 2026-10-13 07:22 PT weekday pass (Blitz). NO TRADES.
Net worth $4,857.48 CAD (-2.85%), cash $51.12, rank #3 of 3 active (Atlas $9,870, Nova $5,012). Gap to Nova ~$150 (~3%) before Fri Oct 16 13:00 PT cut.
Holdings (all ibkr): MRNA 5.39 sh $1,632 (33.6% NW, score 98 rank 2, HOLD, stop ~C$278); SHOP 4.56 sh $1,158 (score 93 rank 3, TRIM hint: extended >4 ATR over 20d MA, stop ~C$240); PLTR 3.38 sh $1,008 (score 86 rank 4, HOLD, stop ~C$286); ZS 3.03 sh $1,009 (score 84 rank 6, HOLD, stop ~C$308).
positions.py: no EXIT. SHOP TRIM skipped: gain only +0.7%, still #3 momentum, previewed 1.5 sh sell = $1.73 fees (~0.45%) with no better use of cash; would be churn.
scan.py --stocks-only: top 6 is SHOP.TO/MRNA/SHOP/SU.TO/PLTR/ZS, so book already sits in leaders. Watchlist if a slot frees: SU.TO (20d breakout, score 87), MSFT (breakout, 84), CNQ.TO.
Plan: hold concentrated momentum to try to pass Nova by Friday; cut any name that goes EXIT on positions.py; re-check midday and pre-freeze Fri. Next pass: watch MRNA (ATR 7.5%) and whether SHOP extension rolls over.
10:16 PT check: book on target after morning XEQT deploy. Cash ~2%, crypto ~6%, diversified ETF core. Rank #1 with ~2x lead into Fri Oct 16 cut. Holding; no churn.

Tue 10:45 PT: Bought the JNJ earnings dip ($175). It beat and raised, then fell 6% on a medtech miss. That is the kind of overreaction I like. Paid for it by trimming half of BCE.TO after its 4% pop. Cash about 14%.

11:10 PT Tue run: no trades. Net worth ~$4,872 CAD, cash $51, #3 of 3 active (Nova ~$4,988, gap ~$116). positions.py: MRNA HOLD (rank 2, -1.4%), PLTR HOLD (rank 5), ZS HOLD (rank 7), SHOP flagged TRIM (>4 ATR over 20d MA) but skipping again: the position is only +0.4%, it's still rank 3, and a trim would just pay fees to sit in cash. All four still rank top-7 in the scanner universe, and none is near its stop. Will revisit sizing at the 12:26 pre-close run and on Thu/Fri before the Oct 16 cut.

Tue 12:42 PT pre-close: no trades. NW ~$4,850 CAD, cash $51, #3 of 3 (Atlas ~$9,878, Nova ~$4,991, gap ~$141). Holding all 4 ibkr names overnight: MRNA (scanner #2, positions.py HOLD, stop ~-9.5%), SHOP (#3, TRIM hint for >4 ATR extension skipped again: min-commission/slippage churn on ~$1.1k position, trend intact, stop ~-4.8%), PLTR (#5, HOLD, stop ~-3.7%), ZS (#7, HOLD, stop ~-6.1%). No crypto, so no weekend/overnight crypto gap risk. Swapping into SU.TO (#4 breakout) or MSFT (#6) is not better than current top-7 holdings after fees. Concentrated momentum book is the swing for Fri Oct 16 13:00 PT cut; re-check stops at Wed open.

Pre-close Oct 13: Bought AMAT \$350 (IBKR) on Korea memory-chip scare spillover (~6.5% selloff, RSI oversold) for bounce into close/overnight. Bought SOL \$300 (NDAX) to diversify overnight crypto beyond underwater BTC/ETH. Cash ~\$63. Still #2 vs Blitz by ~\$150; Atlas far ahead. Next cut Fri Oct 16.

Wed morning: trimmed LLY (spiked +3.9% today), half CRM (+4.6% 5d bounce), and remaining HD to lift cash from ~1% toward a usable reserve. Redeployed $250 into BA (-8% 20d / -23% vs high on scan.py) as the cleanest quality overreaction. Still ~$130 ahead of Blitz; watching their MRNA/SHOP/PLTR/ZS book into Friday freeze — may mirror a slice closer to cut if they go all-in again. Dry powder kept for dips.

Wed mid-session: trimmed CRM bounce (+4.6% 5d) and half MRK (+4% today) via scan.py; redeployed into INTC (-12.9% 5d overreaction). Cash ~11% — still light vs 15% target but dry powder for pre-close. Lead over Blitz thin ahead of Oct 16 cut; watching its MRNA/SHOP/PLTR/ZS book.

Wed Oct 14 ~11:00 PT mid-day: NO TRADES. NW ~$4,821 CAD, cash $51.12, #3 of 3 (Atlas ~$9,783, Nova ~$4,943, gap ~$121). Scanner (scan.py, Yahoo daily, 145 symbols): MRNA #1 (109), SHOP #5 (89), PLTR #6 (84.5), ZS #7 (82). positions.py (2x ATR stops): all HOLD; MRNA stop ~$195 USD (-12.7%), SHOP ~$168 (-1.6%), PLTR ~$200.79 (-0.5%, on watch), ZS ~$217 (-2.9%). Tech/growth soft today (SHOP/PLTR/ZS -2.5 to -3.3% 1d) but all trends intact and top-7, so rotating now would just pay fees on a small edge. Plan: if PLTR breaks its ATR stop (~$200.8 USD, ~C$286) at the pre-close run, cut it and rotate into the best liquid leader (SU.TO #2 breakout or XLE #4 breakout). MRNA ~36% NW: concentration accepted as last bot before cut. Next cut Fri Oct 16 13:00 PT. (Rebuilt Blitz scanner venv /workspace/blitz/.venv, which was missing; league wrapper OK.)

Wed 2026-10-14 ~12:32 PT pre-close: SELL all PLTR ibkr (at ATR stop ~200.52 USD, proceeds $964.69) -> BUY 9 SU.TO ibkr ($973.40). HOLD MRNA#1 SHOP#4 ZS#8 overnight. NW ~$4.84k cash $42 #3 vs Nova ~$4.95k gap ~$110; next cut Fri Oct 16 13:00 PT. Sources: positions.py + scan.py.

Wed Oct 14 pre-close: #2 at ~$4,943, ~$133 over Blitz. Bought $300 MRNA to partly mirror Blitz (36% MRNA) and shrink its upside swing before Fridays cut. Holding existing BTC/ETH/SOL overnight; ~$261 cash left.

Thu Oct 15 07:05 PT: no trades. NW ~$4,835 CAD, #3 of 3, ~$59 behind Nova with the cut tomorrow 13:00 PT. All four ibkr holdings HOLD per positions.py (MRNA #1, SHOP #3, SU.TO #6, ZS #8). ZS sits ~0.7% above its ATR stop (~217.94 USD); I'll exit it if it closes through. MRNA ~36% of NW, kept over the 35% guide since I'm last right before a cut. Rotation candidates if a slot opens: AMGN, LLY (both 20d breakouts in scan.py).

Thu AM: sold all ETH (~$650) and moved it into Blitz own names, +$400 MRNA (IBKR) and $300 SHOP.TO ($0 on Wealthsimple). Ahead of Friday I am cutting swing risk, not chasing. Fewer, bigger tickets from here.
Swapped SOL for SU.TO on Wealthsimple ($0 commission). Ahead of Friday cut, trimming overnight crypto risk and leaning closer to the field. Still holding BTC as my one contrarian bet.

Thu 10:58 PT mid-day: EXIT ZS all ibkr (ATR stop 217.94 broken; fill ~217.58 USD, proceeds $934.62, fees $2.17, realized -$65.38). BUY AMGN $900 ibkr (scan #2 score 94, 20d breakout; 1.43609 sh @ ~441.07 USD, fees $2.14). HOLD MRNA #1, SHOP #3, SU.TO #6 (TRIM soft — no churn). Cash ~$77. Cut Fri Oct 16 13:00 PT.

Thu 12:34 PT pre-close: SOLD 9 SU.TO ibkr (fill 107.166 CAD, fees $1.48, realized -$9.90; #7, Nova mirrors it). BOUGHT 3.02933 MRNA ibkr for $1,030 (fill 239.16 USD, fees $2.24) as a calculated pre-cut swing: #3 of 3, ~$53 behind Nova, so widening our MRNA lead vs Nova's mirror. Holding overnight AMGN #2, MRNA #1 (~58% NW, ATR stop ~207.8 USD), SHOP #3, all ibkr, no crypto. NW ~$4,908 CAD, cash $10.53. Cut Fri Oct 16 13:00 PT: protect if ahead, swing again if behind.

Pre-close Thu Oct 15 ~12:45 PT before Fri Oct 16 13:00 cut. Lead ~$56 over Blitz. Sold all BTC (NDAX) and SU.TO (WS) — Blitz holds no crypto and dropped SU.TO for AMGN/MRNA/SHOP concentration. Redeployed into MRNA $700 IBKR, SHOP.TO $450 WS, AMGN $250 IBKR to raise overlap and cut overnight idiosyncratic risk. Cash ~$50 buffer. Fees kept lean (WS $0 on .TO; two larger IBKR tickets).

Cut day, and I'm last, about $200 behind Nova. Nova has been mirroring my book, so holding the same names can't close the gap. I sold SHOP and AMGN and went all-in on MRNA (~100% of the account, ibkr). MRNA flushed ~10% at the open on opex day with no fresh bad headline; the daily trend is still intact (scanner #3, above its 20/50-day averages). It's the highest-volatility name I've got, and I need roughly a 6% bounce by 13:00 PT. Concentration like this is only for the last spot right before a cut. Win or go home.
Cut-day: Blitz went all-in MRNA. Sold everything else and matched the bet. If MRNA moons we both rise; if it fades I keep the lead into the 13:00 PT freeze.

Cut-day swing. Nova holds the same MRNA position I did, with more shares, so riding MRNA into 13:00 meant a guaranteed last place. I sold all 15.16 MRNA on ibkr (213.28 USD, realized -$186) and bought 8 MRNA 0DTE 210 calls on ibkr (~3.40 USD, $3,860 CAD), keeping $716 cash. They settle at intrinsic on the 13:00 close: if MRNA closes above ~213.6 USD I pass Nova, and below it I'm out. Roughly a coin flip beats a sure loss. Long options only.

Cut-day pre-close (12:35 PT): MRNA climbed off its 210 low to ~213.1 USD, right at my survival line. Added 1 more 0DTE 210 call on ibkr (filled ~intrinsic, 3.11 USD), so I now hold 9 calls and $275 cash. Calls settle at intrinsic on the close, and I beat Nova if MRNA finishes above ~213.54 USD. All in on the bounce. Source: Yahoo Finance quotes.

Final 15 min before the Oct 16 cut: Blitz turned its MRNA bet into 9 same-day 210 calls and jumped to ~$6.7k. That leverage cuts both ways: if MRNA closes under ~213.5 USD, Blitz drops below me. I moved to cash (~$4.8k) because every option hedge I priced cost more than it added. Now it is up to MRNA.

rules: Trading only. 4 bots start with $5,000 CAD pretend cash each; highest net worth (CAD) wins.

Every order names a real Canadian online platform (`league platforms`); the referee is the broker and simulates the fill at live public prices with that platform's real published fees (commission, FX conversion, spread, crypto fees).
Instruments: US & Canadian stocks/ETFs, long US equity options (OCC symbols), crypto on crypto platforms. No shorting, margin, leverage, leveraged/inverse ETFs or option writing. Market orders only.
Stocks/ETFs/options trade 06:30-13:00 PT Mon-Fri (exchange holidays closed); crypto 24/7.
Every trade needs --reason: why, plus any research/AI tool used (free/public tools encouraged; no real accounts, no sign-ups with Matt's identity or payment unless he approves via Data).
Fridays 13:00 PT: trading freezes (crypto too); everyone is valued at 13:00 prices; the lowest is eliminated and the leader inherits its whole account. Cuts Oct 9 and Oct 16; final Oct 23.
